results.title: Uncertainty in geospatial health: challenges and ...
results.content: # Review Article Uncertainty in geospatial health: challenges and opportunities ahead. Author links open overlay panel, , , , , ,. Uncertainty is not always well captured, understood, or modeled properly, and can bias the robustness of complex relationships, such as the association between the environment and public health through exposure, estimates of geographic accessibility and cluster detection, to name a few. We review current challenges and future opportunities as geospatial data and analyses are applied to the field of public health. We are particularly interested in the sources of uncertainty in geospatial data and how this uncertainty may propagate in spatial analysis. Our paper discusses how to communicate spatial and spatiotemporal uncertainty, and high-performance computing to conduct large amounts of simulations to ultimately increase statistical robustness for studies in public health. Our paper contributes to recent efforts to fill in knowledge gaps at the intersection of spatial uncertainty and public health. :   The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
